description: This file defines the NotesProvider class, a state management component for handling notes within a Flutter application. It manages loading, updating, deleting, and filtering notes, interfacing with a NotesRepository for data persistence.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of Note objects, providing methods to load, add, update, delete, and filter notes with notification support for UI updates.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads notes asynchronously from the repository and updates the internal list, notifying listeners during the process.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Alias for initialize, reloads notes from the repository.

methods.name: addOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new note or updates an existing one, then sorts the list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _sort
methods.description: Sorts notes prioritizing pinned notes and recency.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID and updates the list and listeners.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query string and updates filtered notes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID, returns null if not found.
